structured_output.summary: The diff implements Set.prototype.isDisjointFrom in its own file, with a local GetSetRecord helper. I walked the spec steps: RequireInternalSlot via this_set, GetSetRecord (Get size, ToNumber, NaN→TypeError, negative→RangeError, Get has/keys, IsCallable checks, in the spec order), the size comparison, the index-based loop over SetData with thisSize refreshed only after a non-empty entry, Call(has) with ToBoolean, the else branch with GetIteratorFromMethod, IteratorStepValue, SetDataHas and IteratorClose with a normal completion, and the final return true. Every abrupt completion propagates with `?`. Nothing is keyed on test inputs, nothing is hardcoded, and no errors are swallowed. The gate's 14 remaining failures come from other built-ins (Set/Map size getters, Set.prototype.delete) that are not implemented yet, so they surface as honest not-implemented errors. The only deviation I found is cosmetic: the `else` branch lacks the "// 5. Else," comment that the ticket asks for.
